name: Firecrawl API
description: Firecrawl v2 API — turn any URL or search query into clean, LLM-ready markdown. POST /v2/scrape fetches a single page, POST /v2/search runs a web search and returns full page content, POST /v2/map lists a site's URLs, POST /v2/crawl and POST /v2/batch/scrape start async jobs polled via GET /v2/crawl/{id} and GET /v2/batch/scrape/{id}, and POST /v2/extract pulls structured data from pages using a prompt or JSON schema. Auth is handled automatically via the FIRECRAWL_API_KEY environment variable as a Bearer token.
